content.text:
=== alice via startuphafen_app ===
HTTP 200
alice roles: ['activatedUser', 'user']

=== marie via startuphafen_app ===
HTTP 200
marie roles: ['default-roles-startuphafen', 'user']

observation.command: echo "=== alice via startuphafen_app ==="; curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "grant_type=password&client_id=startuphafen_app&username=alice&password=alice" -o /tmp/t_alice.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/t_alice.json')); t=d.get('access_token',''); import base64; p=t.split('.')[1]; p+='='*(-len(p)%4); print('alice roles:', json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p)).get('realm_access',{}).get('roles'))" 2>/dev/null || head -c 200 /tmp/t_alice.json; echo; echo "=== marie via startuphafen_app ==="; curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:28080/realms/startuphafen/protocol/openid-connect/token -d "grant_type=password&client_id=startuphafen_app&username=marie&password=marie" -o /tmp/t_marie.json -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/tmp/t_marie.json')); t=d.get('access_token',''); import base64; p=t.split('.')[1]; p+='='*(-len(p)%4); print('marie roles:', json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(p)).get('realm_access',{}).get('roles'))" 2>/dev/null || head -c 200 /tmp/t_marie.json
